name: Build distributables
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - 'v*'
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**'
    branches-ignore:
      - 'v*'

env:
  WEBCORD_BUILD: DEVEL

permissions: {}

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        deps: ['latest', 'locked']
    name: "Test build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 'latest'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies (NPM)
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.deps == 'latest' }}
        run: npm update --dangerously-allow-all-scripts

      - name: TSC cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          key: tsc-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json', 'tsconfig.json') }}
          path: |
            app
            cache/tsc.json

      - name: Run tests with ${{ matrix.deps }} dependencies
        run: npm test
  make:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        name: ['Linux', 'Windows', 'macOS']
        build: [latest, locked]
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-latest
            name: Linux
            arch: x64,arm64
          - runner: windows-latest
            name: Windows
            arch: x64,arm64
          - runner: macos-latest
            name: macOS
            arch: x64,arm64 #,universal

    name: '${{ matrix.name }} (${{ matrix.build }})'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    needs: ['test']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.name == 'Windows' && '24.x' || 'latest' }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies (NPM)
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.build == 'latest' }}
        run: npm update

      - name: TSC cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          key: tsc-${{ matrix.build }}
          path: |
            app
            cache/tsc.json

      - name: Generate distributables (${{ matrix.arch }})
        uses: nick-fields/retry@v4
        with:
          retry_on: error
          max_attempts: 3
          timeout_minutes: 10
          command: npm run make -- -a ${{ matrix.arch }}

      - name: Upload distributables as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}_${{ matrix.build }}
          path: out/devel/make/*

      - name: Upload lockfile as artifact
        if: ${{ matrix.build == 'latest' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}-lockfile_updated
          path: package-lock.json

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
